notes.title: Playtest 3
notes.content:
This change includes 4 new guns. 

Updated the Castle store to use the castle theme.

Included changes for the UI,
for switching guns and the score screen.

Added one new level, Level_03.

Also added basic bonus system for using different guns.

//Johan
